item.title: Star Wars™ Night is January 30!
item.description: Travel to a galaxy far, far away with us! Friday, January 30 is Stars Wars™ Night! Meet all your favorite characters on the concourse, enjoy galactic concessions, and more! The Stars will wear specialty warmup jerseys based on the Forest Moon of Endor that will be auctioned online. A limited number of replicas will be sold in the Team Store as well. See jersey below. Get your tickets now before they're gone!

item.title: Breakout Season for Stars’ Matthew Seminoff Fueled by Work Ethic
item.description: Matthew Seminoff spent the first five years of his life in Leesburg, Virginia, moving to Coquitlam, British Columbia just as he was entering elementary school. Although he moved more than 2,000 miles to the other side of the continent, it was a place that would fall right in line with his dreams. item.title: Stars Win Goal Fest in Iowa
item.description: DES MOINES, Iowa – The Texas Stars, American Hockey League affiliate of the NHL’s Dallas Stars, stormed back from a two-goal deficit against the Iowa Wild and held off a third period comeback in a 6-4 victory at Casey’s Center on Wednesday. Iowa broke out to an early lead, chipping in two goals in the first period. Dylan Gambrell opened the scoring with a one-timer from the faceoff circle 4:47 into the game. item.title: Stars Blank IceHogs in Third Straight Win
item.description: ROCKFORD, Illinois – The Texas Stars, American Hockey League affiliate of the NHL’s Dallas Stars, shut out the Rockford IceHogs 5-0 on Friday at the BMO Center. Texas struck first just seven minutes into the game when Curtis McKenzie’s pass on an odd-man rush went off an IceHogs stick and past Drew Commesso. That goal was McKenzie’s 200th of his AHL career. item.description: CEDAR PARK, Texas – The Texas Stars, American Hockey League affiliate of the NHL’s Dallas Stars, defeated the Henderson Silver Knights 6-5 in an overtime classic on Friday at the H-E-B Center at Cedar Park. item.title: Dallas Stars Acquire Defenseman Jeremie Poirier from Calgary Flames in Exchange for Defenseman Gavin White
item.description: FRISCO, Texas – Dallas Stars General Manager Jim Nill announced today that the club has acquired defenseman Jeremie Poirier from the Calgary Flames in exchange for defenseman Gavin White. Poirier will be assigned to the Texas Stars, Dallas' development affiliate in the American Hockey League (AHL). Poirier, 23, has recorded six points (1-5—6) in 35 games with the Calgary Wranglers (AHL) this season, while putting up 24 penalty minutes.
